Lemma
[The Horizontal Lift of a Smooth Section Along $\pi $ is Smooth]

↗ def:horizontal-lift-tangent ↗ lem:horizontal-lift-smooth-in-data ↗ def:submersion

If $\pi :\tilde M\to M$ is a smooth submersion with metric $\tilde g$ and $X_x\in T_{\pi (x)}M$ depends smoothly on $x$, then $x\mapsto L_x(X_x)$ is a smooth vector field.

Proof

\sketch In tangent-bundle trivializations the lift is $\mathcal L(B(x),A(x))u(x)$, where $B(x)$ and $A(x)$ represent $\tilde g_x$ and $d\pi _x$, and $u(x)$ represents $X_x$. Lemma 2 gives smoothness.

□
